Is your phone eSIM
compatible?
Most newer phones already support eSIMs, and can install them in 90 seconds.
Compatible devices:
If your phone was made in 2019 or later, there’s a good chance it already supports eSIM. The only usual exceptions are budget models and some phones bought in certain parts of Asia, so most travellers can skip checking entirely.
Locked phones:
Most phones these days are unlocked, which means they can hop onto a new network without any fuss. The main exception can be a phone you’re still paying off on a plan, but carriers will often unlock your phone if you explain it’s for travel use.
Using two SIMs at once:
If you have a dual-SIM phone, you can use a travel eSIM for internet abroad, while still using your regular SIM for calls and texts on your regular phone number. No SIM swapping, and no missed messages from home.
Check my phone
Use a Thailand eSIM to stay connected
From Bangkok, Samut Prakan, Mueang Nonthaburi to the quieter corners of Thailand, staying connected makes every trip easier — for live maps, ride-hailing, translation, mobile payments and sharing the moments as they happen. An aloSIM Thailand eSIM installs in about 90 seconds and connects automatically when you land, so you skip the airport SIM queue and start browsing right away. Every plan includes a free Hushed phone number for calls and texts, plus 24/7 live chat support if you need a hand. Buy before you fly, top up any time, and enjoy reliable data throughout Thailand — and because the eSIM is yours to keep, you can reuse it on your next visit.
How much travel data do I need in Thailand?
In Thailand, data needs will vary from person to person. Consider whether Wi-Fi is offered in your accommodations and how much time you’ll be spending indoors.
If you plan to visit the sites and enjoy the tropical Thai landscapes, then you’re going to need data to stay connected.
The best thing about a Thailand eSIM is that it provides a variety of data packages based on your requirements. You can start with a small data plan and top up as needed!
We also have a
travel data calculator
to help you estimate how much data you’ll need for your trip.
Will I pay roaming charges with an eSIM for Thailand?
There are no roaming charges! A Thailand eSIM securely gives your device access to a local network in Thailand, enabling you to use prepaid data while vacationing!
Just make sure you
turn off Data Roaming on your Primary SIM card
so you won’t see charges on your next bill. Using an eSIM for Thailand can help you save money and make sure you enjoy every moment of your trip!

Does Thailand support eSIM?
Yes. aloSIM works in Thailand on established local network infrastructure, and most phones bought after 2020 already support eSIM if they are carrier-unlocked. Thailand is well set up for eSIM use across its major cities and tourist regions, so aloSIM is a practical way to get data on arrival without buying a SIM at the airport. Check your device on the compatibility page before you buy.
What is the best eSIM for Thailand?
The best Thailand eSIM depends on your data needs, but aloSIM is a strong choice because it combines low prices, 90-second setup, and a free Hushed phone number that many competitors leave out. Plans are priced for travelers, and every plan includes that number for calls, texts and app verification while you travel.
How do I activate an eSIM in Thailand?
Buy your Thailand plan in the aloSIM app before departure, open ‘My eSIMs’, and tap ‘Install eSIM’ — installation takes about 90 seconds. Toggle the eSIM on and allow roaming when you land, and data starts automatically. This is faster and cheaper than hunting for a physical SIM at the airport when you arrive.
Can I use eSIM and my regular SIM at the same time in Thailand?
Yes. aloSIM works with dual-SIM phones, so you can keep your regular SIM for calls and texts while using your Thailand eSIM for mobile data. This gives you local connectivity in Thailand without giving up your usual number — just check your home provider’s roaming charges before you travel. Most travelers keep the home SIM on for calls and route their data through aloSIM to keep costs down.
Does eSIM work in rural areas of Thailand?
Your aloSIM Thailand eSIM runs on AIS, covering populated areas including the major cities and tourist destinations. Coverage can be weaker in more remote and rural areas, as with any mobile network. Download Google Maps offline before heading off-grid so you can still navigate, and reconnect automatically once you return to coverage.
Is pocket WiFi or eSIM better for Thailand travel?
For most travelers, aloSIM is better than pocket WiFi in Thailand because you do not need to carry, charge, pick up or return another device. Pocket WiFi still makes sense for groups of three or more sharing one connection, but an eSIM is easier and often cheaper for solo travelers and couples.
Do I need a Thailand phone number with my Thailand eSIM?
No, but aloSIM gives you a useful alternative. Every Thailand eSIM includes a free Hushed phone number for hotel check-in texts, WhatsApp and local app sign-ups, so you have a reliable number the moment you arrive. That is more flexibility than a standard data-only eSIM from many competitors, which leave the number feature out entirely or charge extra for it.
